$comment: Tier-3 differential spec for the W4.9c STORY_BACKGROUND_GENERATION job handler
(v4 lib/background-jobs/handlers/story-background.ts handleStoryBackgroundGeneration;
Rust crates/quilltap-core/src/services/story_background_job.rs).
ONE committed file drives BOTH sides. A two-database fixture (main + mount-index) is
baked once by build-story-background-job-fixture.ts via v4's REAL repos: a user, a
participant character (with a vault + physicalDescription + depiction-guidelines.md),
a NON-participant user character (Zelda, for the missing-character enumeration append),
image profiles (OPENAI + GROK), two connection profiles (a cheap OPENAI default + an
OLLAMA one used as the imagePromptProfileId uncensored retry selection), an OFF chat
settings row, a provisioned Quilltap General store carrying lantern/aurora-aesthetics.md,
a provisioned Lantern Backgrounds store, and a project P (backgroundDisplayMode
latest_chat) whose official store carries its OWN lantern/aurora-aesthetics.md
(proving the project-over-global aesthetic tier), plus one chat per case (some with
recent messages, one with a fresh scene state).
MODEL SEAMS (pinned identically both sides):
- the image provider (CannedImageProvider keyed by the oracle-recorded key in Rust
to_key_value order; proves the crafted+enumerated prompt + landscape orientation)
- the completion boundary (CannedCompletionProvider; recorded keys prove the
derive-scene / resolve-appearance / craft task prompts byte-for-byte, incl. the
GROK 1000-char length guidance, the aesthetic + Ariel-Clause sections, and the
cheap-vs-uncensored retry selection)
- the WebP transcode (PassthroughTranscoder)
- the API key (canned apiKeyId->key map)
- the orientation registry (OPENAI/GROK size-strategy OrientationSupport)
- the project fileStorageManager.uploadFile (recorded FsSeam, project_latest case)
- Date.now() frozen so the provider filename + minted timestamps are pinned
The completion mock branches on a STORYCASE:<label> marker carried in the chat title
(→ derive/resolve prompts) and echoed by the derive result / scene-state location (→
the craft prompt), plus the provider (cheap OPENAI vs uncensored OLLAMA) for the retry
cases. It returns [] on the cheap provider for appearance_retry (llmResolved false →
uncensored retry) and '' on the cheap provider for empty_craft_retry (silent refusal →
uncensored retry).
SCOPE: the first eight cases run with danger mode OFF, so no classify/sanitize LLM
calls fire and the appearance/craft retries are driven purely by the
imagePromptProfileId uncensored selection (which needs no danger mode).
[decd8ef9] The last five cases cover the uncensored image TARGET branch. A chat
settings row is per-user and the corpus has one user, so a case may carry its own
`dangerousContentSettings` bag: BOTH sides UPDATE the chat_settings row on their
fresh copy with exactly that JSON before the handler runs (the case's danger
settings are as much fixture state as its chat row is).
- danger_candid: a dangerous chat WITH an uncensored image profile -> the crafter
gets the CANDID intimacy guidance (and the appearance sanitizer's rule 2 already
steps aside, which is the agreement the commit is about).
- danger_no_uncensored_image: a dangerous chat WITHOUT one -> still concealed. The
`&&` pin: it is the only case that catches dropping the second conjunct, and it
carries no characters so the sanitizer's rule-3 classify never fires.
- moderation_recraft: an ordinary chat whose image profile is `blocked-model`
(the provider throws a moderation error) -> the post-hoc reroute re-crafts the
prompt CANDIDLY for the target and re-runs the step-9b enumeration pass over the
replacement. The oracle's completion mock branches on the candid marker in the
SYSTEM message, so the re-crafted text names Zelda and the enumeration append is
visible in the reroute's image key + both llm_logs projections.
- moderation_recraft_fails: the same, with the re-craft returning nothing -> the
reroute reuses the concealed prompt and still produces an image.
- moderation_already_candid: a dangerous chat with an uncensored image profile ->
the prompt is candid already, so the reroute does NOT re-craft (ONE
IMAGE_PROMPT_CRAFTING row in llm_logs, not two).
SAFETY: testPepperBase64 is a THROWAWAY 32-byte key. NOT the real Friday pepper.

uncensored_override_candid.$comment: P4.D141 / v4 60e3c4a0a — the four-state feature's MOTIVATING regression, mirroring v4's own new test in story-background-uncensored-target.test.ts: the operator asserts the chat spicy (conciergeOverride='UNCENSORED') while the CLASSIFIER label is false and the GLOBAL Concierge mode is OFF. The resolver must still force AUTO_ROUTE with every scan off, and shouldUseUncensoredRoute must still be true, so the prompt goes out CANDID and bound for the uncensored image profile. Before the four-state port this corner was unreachable.

backfill_absent.$comment: [P4.D146 / v4 70505745a] The step-9b back-fill's exclusion set. Fern is a PRESENT participant and carries the payload; Bram is an ABSENT participant of the same chat and carries nothing; Zelda is unaffiliated with the chat entirely. The crafted prompt names all three (the completion mock's backfill_absent branch), so the enumeration scan is offered all three names and the recorded image key says which it actually appended: Zelda yes, Bram no, Fern no (already handed to the crafter).
